paragraphs.text: At a repair café, volunteers help visitors mend broken things instead of doing the work for them. Most cafés meet once a month in a hall or a library, and there is no charge, though visitors may leave a donation.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Kettles, lamps and clothes are the commonest items. Around six repairs in ten succeed; the rest fail for lack of spare parts. Several cafés keep a list of items they will not touch, such as microwave ovens.
paragraphs.label: B

items.quote: volunteers help visitors mend broken things instead of doing the work for them
items.prompt: Volunteers repair the items while visitors wait.

explanation.en: Volunteers help rather than doing the repair themselves → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Еріктілер өздері жөндемейді, жөндеуге көмектеседі → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Волонтёры помогают чинить, а не чинят сами → FALSE.

items.quote: there is no charge, though visitors may leave a donation
items.prompt: Visitors have to pay a fixed price.

explanation.en: There is no charge; a donation is optional → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Ақы алынбайды, қайырымдылық — қалауы бойынша → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Плата не берётся, пожертвование — по желанию → FALSE.

items.quote: Around six repairs in ten succeed

explanation.en: Six out of ten is most of them → TRUE.
explanation.ru: Шесть из десяти — это большинство → TRUE.

items.quote: a list of items they will not touch, such as microwave ovens
items.prompt: Microwave ovens are the item brought most often.

explanation.en: Microwaves are on the refused list; how often they are brought is not stated → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Микротолқынды пеш — қолға алмайтын тізімде; қаншалықты жиі әкелетіні айтылмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Микроволновки в списке того, за что не берутся; как часто их приносят, не сказано → NOT GIVEN.
